question: White light is an example of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**polychromatic light.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• White light is a combination of all visible colors in the electromagnetic spectrum.
 
• **White light consists of 7 colors.**
 
 
• White light consists of seven component colors:** violet (V), indigo (I), blue (B), green (G), yellow (Y), orange (O), and red (R).**
 
• In order from lowest to highest, the wavelengths of colored light are given by the acronym VIBGYOR (V 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Electromagnetic Waves** are generated due to the vibration between the electric field and the magnetic field and do not require any medium to travel. It can run in a vacuum.
 
• Light is a form of energy that is an example of an electromagnetic wave.
 
• **Wavelength: The distance between two successive crests or troughs is called the wavelength of a wave.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54a0c06d5aa0ad9ce8d32e4a1493550f22059afba9a8aab23d34d2feae13c6a9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Plane polarised light is a type of light in which the electric field oscillates in a single plane.
 
• Monochromatic light is a type of light that consists of a single color or wavelength.
 
• 
 
Laser light is a type of light that is monochromatic, meaning it consists of a single color or wavelength
